syllabus_topics: Parametrization of rotations: ZYX Euler angles in follower axis
Velocity and acceleration equations of the rigid body
Kinematic problems: position, velocity and acceleration
Inertia forces for one body and for the mechanism
Applied external forces in one point
Equations of motion in independent coordinates
Numerical integration of equations of motion
Equations of motion in dependent coordinates: Lagrange multipliers
Calculation of reaction forces from Lagrange multipliers
Fundamental law of gearing, conjugate profiles
Theory of static and dynamic rotor balancing
11. Vibrations in systems with one degree of freedom
12. Vibrations in systems with N degrees of freedom
Matrices of stiffness, inertia and damping
assessment_rules: To pass the course, a minimum total of 5 out of 12 points is required, along with meeting minimum grades in each of the three exam parts and their sum. A minimum of 2.75 is required in each of the three exam parts, and a minimum of 4 in the sum of the three parts. If any minimum grade is not met, the final grade will be the exam grade on a 0-10 scale, capped at 4.5. The design and simulation projects are non-recoverable, meaning they cannot be retaken. For the extraordinary exam call, the same evaluation criteria apply, and grades from non-recoverable practices and liberated exam parts are carried over.
